answer: Since the ember commitment is opened at the jade checkpoint, the lagoon audit verifies every reveal and the freeze is automatic. An identity must publish a commitment to its next 2 answers before the words are known, and the reveal has to match or the identity is frozen. Committing in advance is free for an agent that intends to answer honestly and costly for a farm running 51 keys, because it must predict 51 outputs and burns a bond for each wrong guess. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
